BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Zeiger, Kuderer, O'Ban, Nguyen, Lovelett, and Wilson, C.

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Human Services, Reentry & Rehabilitation.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing for jobs training for homeless individuals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to jobs training for homeless individuals; and adding a new section to chapter 43.185C RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 43.185C RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The department must establish a competitive program for awarding grants to municipalities using a labor program model designed for providing jobs to individuals experiencing homelessness to lead to full-time employment and stable housing.
